newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RTZ-CRA to invest $300 mln in Brazil - report.
newsitem.headline: RTZ-CRA to invest $300 mln in Brazil - report.

text.p: Anglo-Australian mining company RTZ-CRA will invest $300 million in Brazil in 1997 and 1998, human resources and foreign affairs director Lord Holme according to Gazeta Mercantil newspaper.

The money will be invested in the company's Morro do Ouro nickel mine in Minas Gerais state which is also expected to produce as by-products cobalt, copper sulphate, platinum group metals and gold, Gazeta Mercantil said.
In addition, the company will invest money in its coal mine in Corumba, in Mato Grosso do Sul state, it added.
RTZ-CRA officials could not be reached for comment on the report.
Lord Holme is on a four-day visit to Brazil during which he has held talks with government officials as well as visited the company's existing operations.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
